title: Saturnus: the low tide near the KTV room
summary: Saturnus saw the low tide near the KTV room this week (fiction).
body:
Entry for the ledger: one low tide, observed near the KTV room, duration a few seconds. Every line balances except the source, which is still blank. A blank last line is not a zero. Witnesses at the KTV room may report to me.

Fiction: a story notice from the city of Noctiluca. Not a real event, and nothing here was measured.
